How to read and print the files

  • Acrobat: to view Acrobat (.pdf) files, you can use Acrobat Reader.

  • Java: to run Java applets, use a browser that supports Java 1.2 or download the latest Java plug-in.

  • Powerpoint: to view PowerPoint files (.ppt), use a browser that supports viewing them, or download a free PowerPoint viewer. If the equations don't view properly, be sure you have the Symbol and MT Extra fonts. Installing the Microsoft Equation Editor (from Windows setup) will accomplish this.

  • To print the PowerPoint files, we recommend printing 4 or 6 to the page. To get the best results, don't use the PowerPoint "Print -> Handout" option. Instead, use "Print -> Properties -> Advanced -> Pages Per Sheet -> 6 Landscape." Also, we recommend selecting "Print -> Properties -> Page Setup -> Color" and deselecting "Print -> Grayscale", even if you have a black and white printer.

  • The style file used to print the slides is cs423-handouts.pot; the style file used to to display the slides in lecture is cs423-cos104.pot.


Acknowledgments

These lecture notes were heavily influenced by the unpublished manuscript Introduction to Algorithms, written by Jon Kleinberg and Éva Tardos. The lecture notes also adapt material from the following sources.

  • A. Aho, J. Hopcroft, J. Ullman. The Design and Analysis of Computer Algorithms. Addison-Wesley, 1974.
  • R. K. Ahuja, T. L. Magnanti, J. B. Orlin. Network Flows. Prentice-Hall, 1993.
  • G. Brassard, P. Bratley. Fundamentals of Algorithmics. Prentice-Hall, 1996.
  • T. Cormen, C. Leiserson, R. Rivest. Introduction to Algorithms. McGraw-Hill, 2001.
  • M. Garey and D. Johnson. Computers and Intractability: A Guide to the Theory of NP-Completeness. W.H. Freeman, 1979.
  • D. Gusfield and R. Irving. The Stable Marriage Problem. MIT Press, 1989.
  • U. Manber. Introduction to Algorithms -- A Creative Approach. Addison Wessley, 1989.
  • D. Kozen. The Design and Analysis of Algorithms. Springer-Verlag, 1992.
  • R. E. Tarjan. Data Structures and Network Algorithms. SIAM, 1983.
Instructors: if you use these slides in class, please provide a link back to this page.
